description: Diagnostic module to investigate build failure for email_guid_auth.py and email_guid_auth_compact. Inspects the build artifact by reading the source file, checking import statements against available modules, and identifying missing dependencies or import conflicts. Does NOT import any protected modules. Outputs a structured diagnostic report identifying the specific failure cause (missing import, circular dependency, syntax error, etc.) with remediation recommendations. Pure diagnostic only - no writes to DB or state.
